description: This file defines a custom matcher function 'toMatchAriaSnapshot' for testing ARIA snapshots in Playwright, including logic for snapshot comparison, file handling, and snapshot generation.

methods.name: toMatchAriaSnapshot
methods.description: Asynchronous function that compares a locator's ARIA snapshot against a stored snapshot, with support for snapshot creation and updates.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Removes common leading whitespace from each line in a snapshot string.

methods.description: Indents each line of a snapshot string with a specified indentation.
